Turk's comments come as an Israeli operation in the occupied West Bank city of Hebron, which began on Friday, has forcibly displaced more than 2,000 Palestinians from the city. "The sweeping steps taken raise grave concerns of unnecessary and disproportionate use of force, which must end," said Turk. "Collective punishment is a grave violation of international law," he added.

articles.title: Odd Lots: The Forgotten Godmother of Economic Literature
